newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Haddowe Ltd completes HK$475 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Haddowe Ltd completes HK$475 mln loan.

text.p: Haddowe Ltd's HK$475 million transferable loan facility has been completed, lead manager Rabobank Hong Kong branch said on Wednesday.
The borrower is a subsidiary of Pacific Capital (Holdings) Ltd, which is in the property business in Hong Kong and China.
The loan has a maturity of five years and an average life of four years. It pays a margin of 250 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 270 basis points.

Lead managers are Rabobank Hong Kong branch, with HK$135 million, International Bank of Asia and Nanyang Commercial Bank, with HK$75 million each, and Hamburgische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, with HK$60 million.
Co-lead managers, with HK$40 million each, are Creditanstalt Asia and China & South Sea Bank Hong Kong branch.
Managers are Jian Sing Bank, with HK$30 million, and Indover Asia, with HK$20 million.
